latin: Cur homo non possit non uideri si sit presens a recte disposito in potentia uisiua, demon autem tunc solum uideatur cum uult uideri, ex modo quo unusquisque eorum uidetur haberi potest.
translation: Consider the manner in which each is seen, and you will grasp why a man, once present before someone rightly equipped to see, cannot help being seen, whereas a demon becomes visible only when it chooses to be.
